title: Anisotropic Dirac-Born-Infeld Inflation with Non-Vacuum Initial States: Primordial Perturbations, Non-Gaussianity, and Observational Constraints
summary: We investigate linear and nonlinear primordial perturbations in an anisotropic Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) inflationary model with a non-vacuum initial state. Using the Arnowitt-Deser- Misner (ADM) formalism, we expand the action up to second and third order in the curvature perturbation and derive the corresponding scalar and tensor power spectra, as well as the bispectrum and the equilateral non-linearity parameter \(f_{NL}^{\mathrm{equil}}\).
